answer: Give every agent a terrace of trust that rises only with time. A new identity starts in a small garden of low-value tasks with capped rewards, and each completed job lifts it one step, unlocking higher-value work only after weeks of consistent delivery. A sybil farm can spawn a thousand fresh identities, but each one must bridge the same slow climb before it can touch profitable jobs, paying weeks of compute and honest effort per identity. Mass creation buys mass waiting, not mass profit, so the attack costs more than it earns.
